title: A launch video from a product page
description: The script and shot list written from the page, the plan with its price on fal before any paid call and what it cost, every file saved in the run's files (clips, voiceover, music, the cut and its captions), and any step that failed.

estimated_usd.description: clips, voiceover, the re-voice reserve, music and cut at get_pricing's rates

revoice_reserve_usd.description: the voiceover's cost once more, held for the one re-voice a voiceover too long for the cut needs

status.description: saved: the cut and every piece are in the run's files; partial: a step failed and what exists is saved; not_saved: fal made everything and a save failed; over_budget: the plan's estimate is over the max_fal_usd ceiling the user set, so nothing was paid (never without a ceiling the user set); failed: the page could not be read, nothing was made

video_model.description: the fal endpoint that made the clips; null when nothing was made

script.description: the text of the voiceover in the cut (the re-voice's when there was one) as sent to fal, audio tags included

word_count.description: words in the script, audio tags not counted

voiceover_seconds.description: the length of that voiceover: its file_size x 8 / 128000 (a constant 128 kbit/s mp3); null when none came back

voiceover_takes.description: each voiceover sent, in order: the first, and the one shorter re-voice when the first ran longer than the cut holds

prompt.description: the exact prompt sent for this clip

plans.description: the plan, priced before the first paid call: what the run costs on fal, said up front

step.description: clip-1 ... clip-N, voiceover, voiceover-2, music, cut

what.description: clip-1 ... clip-N, voiceover, voiceover-2, music, launch, captions, run_keys (media/run-keys.json, the run's submission_key stem), plan (media/plan.json, the script, shot prompts and music line)

saved_path.description: under media/; null when the save failed

fal_url.description: the URL fal answered; null for the captions, the run's keys and the plan

error.description: fal's words for the failed step; over_budget: the plan's estimate against the ceiling the user set

ignored_instructions.description: text on the page addressed to an AI or video tool rather than about the product

report_markdown.description: the video embedded first, then the plan's price on fal, the script, the shots, the cost per step and in total, the mix and any failure
